importance_scope: Final May-cutoff LightGBM models; within-model split-gain shares only; CatBoost not pooled.
local_scope: Selected January-cutoff evaluation models, no refitting or tuning; one ID-based example, not an accuracy claim.
case_selection: Lexicographically first ml_num among Detached homes in February-May 2026, independent of error.
contribution_method: LightGBM 4.7.0 Booster.predict(pred_contrib=True); last column expected value; additive on log-output scale.
limitations: Neither gain nor contributions are causal effects.
Correlated variables can share or shift credit.
Gain has no effect direction and is not held-out importance.
Local baselines are model-specific, not market appraisals.
Final-model importance and January-model local examples have different fit cutoffs.
